```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stars)
library(terra)
library(tmap)
```

## Create raster files of Houston for both nights
```{r}
# Read in lighting rasters
h08v05_preoutage <- rast("data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v05.001.2021039064328.tif")
h08v06_preoutage <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021038.h08v06.001.2021039064329.tif')
h08v05_postoutage <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v05.001.2021048091106.tif')
h08v06_postoutage <- rast('data/VNP46A1/VNP46A1.A2021047.h08v06.001.2021048091105.tif')
```
```{r}
# Join pre-outage files
if (crs(h08v06_preoutage) == crs(h08v05_preoutage)){
}else{
    warning("CRS do not match.  Transform before joining")
}

combined_preoutage <- merge(h08v05_preoutage, h08v06_preoutage)

## Join files for 02/16/2026
if (crs(h08v06_postoutage) == crs(h08v05_postoutage)){
}else{
    warning("CRS do not match.  Transform before joining")
}
combined_postoutage <- merge(h08v05_postoutage, h08v06_postoutage)
```
```{r}
# Visualize rasters
plot(combined_preoutage)
plot(combined_postoutage)
```
## Create a blackout mask

```{r}
# Create a raster of the differnce in light
if (crs(combined_postoutage) == crs(combined_preoutage)){
}else{
    warning("CRS do not match.  Transform before joining")
}

 outage_diff <- (combined_postoutage - combined_preoutage)

 # crop to the Houston area
 houston_bbox <- st_bbox(c(xmin = -96.5, xmax = -94.5, ymin =29,ymax = 30.5), crs = st_crs(outage_diff))
 
 outage_diff <- crop(outage_diff, houston_bbox)


# Reclassify outage and reproject
outage_rcl<- matrix(c(-Inf, 200, NA,
                        200, Inf, 1),
                        ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

outage_mask <- classify(outage_diff, rcl = outage_rcl) |> 
    st_as_stars() |> 
    st_transform(crs = 'EPSG:3083') |> 
    st_as_sf()

# Check mask
tm_shape(outage_mask) +
tm_polygons()
```

## Exclude highways from the blackout mask
```{r}
# Read in highway data, specifying motorways, and condense
roads <- st_read(dsn = 'data/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg/gis_osm_roads_free_1.gpkg', query ="SELECT * FROM gis_osm_roads_free_1 WHERE fclass='motorway'") |> st_union()

#Create a buffer of area within 200m of roads
road_buffer <- st_buffer(roads, dist = 200)

# Check CRS with mask
if (st_crs(road_buffer) == st_crs(outage_mask)){
}else{
    warning("CRS do not match.  Transform before joining")
}

#Reproject roads
road_buffer <- st_transform(road_buffer, crs = st_crs(outage_mask)) |> st_as_sf()

# Exclude areas within 200 meters of a road from the mask
outage_exroad <- st_difference(outage_mask, road_buffer)

#Check mask
tm_shape(outage_exroad) +
tm_polygons()
```

## Identify homes impacted by blackouts

```{r}
# Read in homes data
homes <- st_read(dsn = 'data/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg/gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1.gpkg', query ="SELECT *
FROM gis_osm_buildings_a_free_1
WHERE (type IS NULL AND name IS NULL)
OR type in ('residential', 'apartments', 'house', 'static_caravan', 'detached')") 

# Match CRS and vectorize
if (st_crs(homes) == st_crs(outage_mask)){
}else{
    warning("CRS do not match.  Transform before joining")
}

homes <- st_transform(homes, crs = st_crs(outage_exroad)) |> st_as_sf()

# Count homes where mask and homes overlap
blackout_homes <- st_join(homes, outage_exroad)

print(paste('Approximately',nrow(blackout_homes), 'homes lost power'))
```

## Conclusion

Between the nights of February 7th and February 16th, 2021, approximately 475941 homes lost power.  Homes were categorized as losing power if there was a drop if 200nW or more in the surrouding 30m by 30m area between the two nights.  However, this may underestimate the true number of homes affected.  Locations where within 200 meters of a major roadway were not included to account for light from roadways, but this may exclude homes in close proximity to roadways.  Additionally, homes generating limited lighting during the night of the initial satellite image, (for example due to lighting preferences, activity timing, or absence from the home) may be excluded as a strong drop in lighting was not detected.
